Name: Flight of Wings
Author: B612XXXXX
Description:
[b]Flight of Wing [/b]
[b]Updated on October 8, 2026: [/b]
[i][b]Version 2.0 of the mod is finally here![/b][/i]
If you have already unlocked the Angel Wings and reached 8 hearts with Haley, you will receive a letter from her.
Complete her request by growing a beautiful field of flowers for Haley, and you’ll be rewarded with a brand-new pair of wings.
The Mystery Wings have the same functions and controls as the Angel Wings.
I won’t reveal the new wing design just yet — I can’t wait to see your screenshots of your characters wearing the Mystery Wings!
[b]Updated on September 22, 2026:[/b]
[list]
[*]Wings automatically fold when entering or leaving rooms.[/*]
[*]Wing status is reset every night when saving.[/*]
[*]Fixed the player getting stuck when triggering a main story event in flight mode. [/*]
[/list]Bring a little magic to your daily life in Stardew Valley with animated angel wings!
Visit Hat Mouse’s shop in Cindersap Forest and purchase [b]Angel Wings for 1,000g[/b] to permanently unlock flight for your character. Your wings are a skill: they require no equipment and take up no inventory space.
Summon your wings, glide over supported water and fences, and explore the valley with a little extra speed.
[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Permanent flight unlocked through Hat Mouse’s shop.[/*]
[*]Default flight speed of [b]1.65× your normal movement speed[/b].[/*]
[*]Flight over supported water tiles, player-built fences and recognized low map fences.[/*]
[*]Automatic climbing when approaching supported low obstacles.[/*]
[*]Use tools, talk to villagers, open chests and fish while airborne.[/*]
[*]A purchase tutorial and instructions available under [b]Options → Controls[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]How to Get Your Wings[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Visit Hat Mouse’s shop in Cindersap Forest once it opens through normal game progression.[/*]
[*]Purchase [b]Angel Wings for 1,000g[/b].[/*]
[*]Read the tutorial and start flying![/*]
[/list][b]Default Controls[/b]
Keyboard:
[list]
[*][b]F8:[/b] Summon your wings and take off.[/*]
[*][b]F8 again:[/b] Land on safe ground and fold away your wings.[/*]
[*][b]F10:[/b] Emergency recovery to safe ground if you get stuck.[/*]
[/list]Controller:
[list]
[*][b]Tap and release L3 / Left Stick Click:[/b] Take off or land.[/*]
[*][b]Hold L3 for 1.2 seconds while flying:[/b] Emergency recovery.[/*]
[/list]L3 means pressing the left stick inward, rather than moving it.
You must be on clear, safe ground to take off or land. Landing on water, fences or occupied tiles is blocked. If you request a landing during a tool action, it waits until the action ends. 
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod’s ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Place the [b]AngelWingsVisualPreview[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Visit Hat Mouse to purchase your wings.[/*]
[/list]When updating, close the game first, replace the mod’s files and keep your existing [b]config.json[/b].
[b]Requirements and Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley — developed against [b]version 1.6.15[/b].[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.1 or later[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Single-player only[/b]; multiplayer and split-screen are not supported.[/*]
[*]Developed on Windows. Other platforms and game versions have not been verified.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher and Fashion Sense are not required.[/*]
[/list]Custom maps and mods that change terrain or collision may require additional compatibility work.
[b]Configuration[/b]
Edit [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder to customize your keyboard and controller buttons, flight speed, wing size, hover height and automatic climbing.
[b]Credits[/b]
Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, and to the SMAPI team and Stardew Valley modding community for their tools and documentation.
